the design of a new class of selective MMP inhibitors based on the 3,4-dihydro-2H-1,3-benzoxazine scaffold and a novel approach for the development of selective inhibitors.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AutoDock and DOck are complementary in their performance, and that both programs are suitable for use in virtual screening.
AutoDock and DOck are complementary tools that can be used to complement each other in a rational drug design process.
AutoDock is a reliable and efficient tool for the docking of inhibitors into the active site of MMPs, and is a valuable tool for the design and optimization of novel inhibitors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
AutoDock is the program of choice for docking studies with inhibitors containing up to six different atom types.
AutoDock is a very useful tool for virtual screening, and it should be used in combination with DOCK.
AutoDock is a very reliable tool for the design and optimization of selective MMP inhibitors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of AutoDock for the design of selective MMP inhibitors is highly recommended.
the design of selective inhibitors of MMPs should focus on the S1’ pocket and the hydrophobic S2’ pocket, which are the most variable regions of the MMPs.
